title: Extract VOIs
description: Crops one VOI (image + mask) per organ side from the selected segmentation set. Sides come from patient coordinates, so prone and feet-first scans are handled. Writes NIfTI in RAS and a voi_catalog.jsonl into the derived root.

region.x-help: Kidney and lung give one VOI per side; the others one VOI around the organ

labels.x-help: Label names that make up the VOI; empty uses the region's labels

margin_mm.x-help: Added around the labels on every side; empty uses the region's margin

min_size_mm.x-help: Minimum VOI size (x, y, z) in mm; empty uses the region's size

resample_mm.x-help: Isotropic voxel size of the output; 0 keeps the scan's voxels

skip_existing.x-help: Leave out scans that already have VOIs in the project; off extracts them again into this run's folder

keep_labels.x-help: Keep every label in the mask crop; off writes a binary mask of the VOI labels

overrides.x-help: Reviewer decisions from the VOI view: swap sides or exclude VOIs per item
